title: Authentication Slice Proof Command Semantics
description: Draft command semantic instance for the USF proof-only authentication slice harness and the historical proof commands that informed its design.
aiGuidance: This command instance records proof-command semantics only. The USF proof harness may emit evidence when explicitly run with write mode. Historical React commands remain lineage evidence and must not be executed as USF proof commands or treated as implementation authority.
purpose: Represent the proof-command boundary for the authentication login API, audit event, workflow, hermetic mock provider, and hermetic environment slice before implementation extraction.
outputs: machine-readable command summary on standard output
sideEffects: writes proof evidence and evidence envelopes only when invoked in write-evidence mode
prints a generated summary that remains lower authority than committed evidence records
failureSemantics: Missing semantic inputs, unresolved references, stale claim commit, provider/environment mismatch, proof overclaim, missing emitted evidence, or missing collected evidence fails closed. Hermetic proof must not satisfy live-external-provider or production-live readiness.
